statement: A prospective customer must complete KYC by submitting Aadhaar and PAN identifiers before an account can be opened.
rationale: v1 in-scope item 'Customer on-boarding with KYC (Aadhaar, PAN)' requires identity capture as the entry point to onboarding.

statement: Aadhaar and PAN values submitted during KYC must pass a format validation check before being accepted.
rationale: Scope agreement states KYC verification is 'format check only, mocked', which implies a format-validation step must exist even though real verification does not.

statement: Real-time verification of Aadhaar/PAN against government or issuing-authority systems is excluded from v1; verification is mocked.
rationale: Scope agreement explicitly excludes real Aadhaar/PAN verification, limiting the system to format checks only.

statement: A newly on-boarded account must pass through an activation step before it can be used for transactions.
rationale: In-scope item 'Account on-boarding and activation' distinguishes account creation from activation as separate steps.

statement: Only authenticated users may access Customer or Bank operations functionality; login with valid credentials is required.
rationale: 'Login' is a standalone in-scope item for both roles, and role-based access is a stated project objective.

statement: An authenticated user must be able to explicitly end their session via logout.
rationale: 'Logout' is a standalone in-scope item for both roles.

statement: Only the Customer role may initiate a money transfer from their own account; Bank operations is explicitly barred from initiating transfers.
rationale: In-scope item 'Money transfer' is scoped to Customer only, and the Bank operations role description states it 'cannot transfer'.

statement: All money movement in v1 is synthetic; no real funds are moved between real financial institutions or accounts.
rationale: Scope agreement explicitly excludes real money movement, limiting transfers to simulated balances.

statement: A Customer account must be able to receive an incoming money transfer and reflect it as a credit to the account balance.
rationale: 'Money receive' is a standalone in-scope item for the Customer role.

statement: Both Customer and Bank operations roles may view an account statement.
rationale: In-scope item 'Statement view' lists both roles as permitted viewers.

statement: The Customer role may download their account statement as a file.
rationale: In-scope item 'Statement download' is scoped to the Customer role only.

statement: Bank operations must be able to review a submitted KYC application and approve or reject it.
rationale: The Bank operations role description states it 'reviews KYC', which is required to complete the onboarding item.

statement: Bank operations must be able to activate or freeze a Customer account.
rationale: The Bank operations role description states it 'activates/freezes accounts', supporting the account on-boarding and activation item.

statement: Bank operations must have access to an audit trail of account and transaction state changes.
rationale: The Bank operations role description states it 'views audit trail', and the charter requires auditable state changes.

statement: Beneficiary management (adding, editing, or removing payees) is excluded from v1 and will not be built.
rationale: Scope agreement lists beneficiary management under out of scope, 'not on build list'.

statement: Notifications (e.g., transaction or account alerts) are excluded from v1 and will not be built.
rationale: Scope agreement lists notifications under out of scope, 'not on build list'.

statement: Service requests (e.g., customer support ticketing) are excluded from v1 and will not be built.
rationale: Scope agreement lists service requests under out of scope, 'not on build list'.

statement: Every state-changing action on an account or transaction must be recorded in a way that supports an auditable history.
rationale: Charter objective requires demonstrating role-based access with 'auditable state changes'.

statement: Agent-produced pipeline artifacts (BRD, designs, code, tests, defect analyses) must be reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, and source-linked, and remain subject to human approval before being treated as approved.
rationale: Charter objective requires agent output to be 'reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, source-linked, and subject to human approval'.

statement: Security, privacy, accessibility, reliability, and testability are mandatory acceptance conditions for every in-scope feature, not optional enhancements.
rationale: Charter objective states these qualities are acceptance conditions, not optional polish.
